blocks.text: B1-04 · The maṣdar
Lesson overview

The maṣdar ( ⁧المَصْدَر⁩ , "source" is the name of action: ⁧زَارَ⁩ • visited • • ⁧زِيَارَة⁩ The visit, the visit. You've known him since A2 as a single word; a B1 It becomes a construction. The language of newspapers, laws and public notices prefers the maṣdar to the verb: The Minister's visit to Cairo instead of the Minister's visit to Cairo is necessary,  the reservation is required instead of the reservation must be made. Who can't take down a chain of maṣdar He doesn't understand a newspaper headline. In this unity learn the forms of maṣdar, how it holds subject and complements and how it replaces subordinate phrases. Two weeks.

rows: 12–14 hours · two weeks (weeks 102–103), plus the EGY track

blocks.text: Materials This unit, dictionary by root, Grammar G44, script for speech synthesis, session with tutor
Targets. At the end of the lesson you know:
1. Recognize the main patterns of maṣdar form I and find them in the dictionary;
2. to safely form the maṣdar For the purposes of this Regulation, the following definitions apply:
3. use the maṣdar in place of ⁧أَنْ⁩ + verb;
4. build the maṣdar with its subject and its complement ( ⁧زِيَارَةُ الوَزِيرِ لِلْقَاهِرَةِ⁩ );
5. use preposition + maṣdar instead of a subordinate sentence ( ⁧بَعْدَ وُصُولِهِ⁩ , ⁧مِنْ أَجْلِ الحُصُولِ عَلَى⁩ …) e
deny with ⁧عَدَم⁩ ;
6. form abstract names in ⁧ـِيَّة⁩ and read notices and titles built with the maṣdar.

2. The maṣdar of form I

In form I maṣdar It is not predictable: every verb has its own, and must be learned with the verb (the dictionary indicates it immediately after the imperfect). However, some schemes are very frequent.

rows: the most frequent for transitive verbs
frequent for intransitive, movement or state verbs

blocks.text: One verb, two maṣdar. Some verbs have more maṣdar with different shades: ⁧بَدَأَ⁩ → ⁧بَدْء⁩ • the act of beginning • and ⁧بِدَايَة⁩ • the beginning of the journey; ⁧قَبِلَ⁩ → ⁧قَبُول⁩ • acceptance, admission • In the dictionary the maṣdar The most common is the first.
3. The maṣdar of derived forms
From form II onwards maṣdar is regular: just know the scheme.

The vowel trick. In maṣdar of VII, VIII and X the vowel before the last radical is always ā long, and the initial hamza is of union ( ⁧اِ⁩ ): ⁧اِجْتِمَاع⁩ , but ⁧وَاجْتِمَاعُ⁩ … ( B1-02). II and V should not be confused. ⁧تَطْوِير⁩ (II) is the development of something with an agent: ⁧تَطْوِيرُ المَشْرُوعِ⁩ • the development of the project; ⁧تَطَوُّر⁩ (V) is the evolution without agent: ⁧تَطَوُّرُ الوَضْعِ⁩ The situation is changing. Weak roots (recognize). You'll see them in depth in B1-06.

Three transformations from verb to verb maṣdar: ⁧أَنْ يَحْجِزُوا⁩ → ⁧حَجْز⁩ , ⁧أَنْ يُحْضِرُوا⁩ → ⁧إِحْضَار⁩ (IV), ⁧لَمْ يَحْضُرْ⁩ → ⁧عَدَمُ الحُضُورِ. إِلْغَائِهِ⁩ The following shall be deleted: maṣdar with an object pronoun. ⁧أَدَّى إِلَى⁩ • lead to, result in, cause. ⁧المَصَادِر⁩ is the plural of ⁧مَصْدَر. شُبَّاك⁩ • • door • ⁧حَجْز⁩ Bookings are not included. ⁧صَبْر⁩ • patience • ⁧طَابُور⁩ • Line, queue.
6. The maṣdar in place of ⁧أَنْ⁩ + verb
After verbs and expressions like ⁧يُرِيدُ⁩ , ⁧يُحِبُّ⁩ , ⁧يَجِبُ⁩ , ⁧يُمْكِنُ⁩ , ⁧يَبْدَأُ⁩ , ⁧يُحَاوِلُ⁩ , ⁧يَرْفُضُ⁩ you can use ⁧أَنْ⁩ + verb or verb maṣdar.

rows: You have to register by Friday.

blocks.text: Which choice? The maṣdar It is more impersonal and more formal: it does not say who does the action. If the subject counts, use ⁧أَنْ⁩ + verb: ⁧يَجِبُ أَنْ تُسَجِّلُوا⁩ You must sign up (you) or add ⁧عَلَى⁩ : ⁧يَجِبُ عَلَيْكُمُ التَّسْجِيلُ.⁩
7. The subject and the complement of maṣdar
The maṣdar It retains the "valence" of its verb: it can have a subject, an object complement and the preposition of the verb.

rows: the visit of the Minister to Cairo
after his arrival, after he arrived
obtaining a visa · attendance at the meeting

blocks.text: To be recognized. In the literary language, the object can be the accusative after the subject: ⁧زِيَارَةُ الوَزِيرِ القَاهِرَةَ⁩ . In the newspapers it is more common to see lām. The preposition remains. If the verb holds a preposition, the maṣdar preserve: ⁧حَصَلَ عَلَى⁩ → ⁧الحُصُولُ عَلَى⁩ ;
⁧وَافَقَ عَلَى⁩ → ⁧المُوَافَقَةُ عَلَى⁩ ; ⁧بَحَثَ عَنْ⁩ → ⁧البَحْثُ عَنْ.⁩
8. Preposition + maṣdar: the subordinates are included
Many Italian subordinate phrases correspond in Arabic to preposition + maṣdar.

rows: after the train has arrived · before leaving

9. The name of a time

The scheme ⁧فَعْلَة⁩ indicates a single act: ⁧جَوْلَة⁩ "One lap' means: ⁧نَظْرَة⁩ "One look" ⁧ضَرْبَة⁩ A blow is a blow, ⁧دَعْوَة⁩ It's an invitation. In the derived forms is added ⁧ـة⁩ to maṣdar: ⁧اِبْتِسَامَة⁩ A smile is a smile. ⁧اِنْطِلَاقَة⁩ It's a start, an impulse. You recognize it because you can count: ⁧نَظْرَتَانِ⁩ Two looks at each other, ⁧جَوْلَاتٌ عِدَّةٌ⁩ • Several laps.
10. Pronunciation

The long vowels of maṣdar. taṣǧīl, iǧtimāʿ, istiḫdām: the long vowel must be held, otherwise the word is not recognized. Read the section table aloud 3 in the column, then in line. The genome of V and II. taṭawwur, tawaqquf tadaḫḫul: the double is heard. Couples to practice with the tutor: taṭwīr / taṭawwur, taqdīm / taqaddum. Union after article and prepositions. fī l-iǧtimāʿ, li-l-istiḫdām, wa-ntišār: the i of form VII.X falls (B1-02).
